sections.headline: Why Independent Debt Verification Matters
sections.content:
Kenya's debt debate often narrows to sensational headlines during annual budget presentation. Behind the public discourse lies a complex web of multilateral agreements, bilateral loans, and domestic commercial paper.

Budget Ndio Story provides verified tracking of these obligations to ensure civil society, institutional partners, and newsrooms have reliable empirical baselines that withstand parliamentary and judicial scrutiny.

pages.title: County Fiscal Transparency Initiative 2026
pages.seoDescription: Citizen-led public expenditure tracking and devolution oversight across Kenya's 47 counties.
pages.headline: Citizen-Led County Budget Tracking & Devolution Oversight
pages.body: A nationwide civic monitoring initiative empowering grassroots communities, youth advocates, and local reporters with forensic budget analysis to verify public expenditure.
pages.content:
Devolution promised to bring resources closer to the people, yet county procurement bottlenecks, pending bills, and under-disbursement of equalization funds continue to impede community development.

The County Fiscal Transparency Initiative combines on-the-ground civic audits with real-time statutory disbursement records released by the Controller of Budget. By transforming dry fiscal reports into accessible community dashboards and local townhall briefings, we enable everyday citizens to ask the right questions about clinic supplies, rural access roads, and early childhood education funds.
